spatial.the-room-list-gives-the-same-inf: The room list gives the same information as text.
spatial.scanning-isn-t-available-on-this: Scanning isn't available on this device
spatial.room-scanning-needs-a-lidar-sens: Room scanning needs a LiDAR sensor. You can build your home manually instead; every other feature works the same.
spatial.walk-slowly-through-each-room-sc: Walk slowly through each room. Scan all rooms in one visit so they line up.
spatial.the-scan-stays-on-this-phone-no-: The scan stays on this phone. No video or photos are saved.
spatial.a-scan-shows-layout-not-safety-y: A scan shows layout, not safety. You'll confirm doors and exits afterwards.
spatial.before-routes-can-use-this-scan: Before routes can use this scan
spatial.no-markers-yet-add-smoke-alarms-: No markers yet. Add smoke alarms and a meeting point.
spatial.tap-a-room-opening-or-marker-to-: Tap a room, opening or marker to edit it. The lists below provide the same controls.
spatial.you-re-editing-the-fictional-sam: You're editing the fictional sample home. Start your own to describe your real layout.
spatial.sizes-are-estimates-and-are-mark: Sizes are estimates and are marked "needs measurement" until you measure them.
spatial.somewhere-everyone-can-reach-e-g: Somewhere everyone can reach, e.g. the neighbor's mailbox
spatial.layout-corrections-can-change-co: Layout corrections can change connections. Review doors and routes after a correction.
spatial.i-checked-this-as-an-escape-opti: I checked this as an escape option for the person who would use it
spatial.label: Label
spatial.an-obstacle-stays-excluded-from-: An obstacle stays excluded from route geometry. Remove it only if the actual obstruction is gone.
spatial.i-checked-this-connection-in-per: I checked this connection in person
spatial.windows-are-exits-only-if-everyo: Windows are exits only if everyone who would use it can open it and climb out, on the ground floor.
spatial.those-items-stay-unconfirmed-and: Those items stay unconfirmed and out of every practice route. You can come back to them from the Home tab.
spatial.routes-still-depend-on-complete-: Routes still depend on complete geometry, usable connections and the person’s needs. Remaining validation issues appear in your home review.
spatial.a-walkout-level-still-needs-each: A walkout level still needs each exterior opening checked. Stairs need both landings confirmed.
spatial.opens-without-a-key-or-tool: Opens without a key or tool
spatial.not-sure-leave-it-out-of-routes: Not sure — leave it out of routes
spatial.no-such-room-or-not-sure-decide-: No such room, or not sure — decide later
spatial.a-household-chosen-spot-is-not-a: A household-chosen spot is not an engineered safe room. Manufactured homes need a sturdy building planned in advance.
spatial.sample-home-fictional-build-or-s: Sample home (fictional). Build or scan your own home to rehearse it.
spatial.scanned-layout-doors-and-exits-c: Scanned layout. Doors and exits count only after you confirm them.
spatial.camera-access-is-off-for-dry-run: Camera access is off for Dry Run. Turn it on in Settings to scan, or edit the layout by hand.
spatial.room-scanning-needs-an-iphone-wi: Room scanning needs an iPhone with LiDAR. Manual layout works on every device.
spatial.assign-each-person-to-the-room-w: Assign each person to the room where a rehearsal should start. Leave a person unassigned when the answer is unknown; Dry Run will report that explicitly instead of guessing.
spatial.this-text-note-is-kept-separate-: This text note is kept separate from indoor floor-plan coordinates.
spatial.add-a-text-meeting-point-in-the-: Add a text meeting point in the home review, or choose a geographic planning point.
spatial.saved-privately-a-map-point-does: Saved privately. A map point does not certify a safe outdoor path.
spatial.nothing-outstanding-in-the-home-: Nothing outstanding in the home model.
spatial.some-opening-measurements-still-: Some opening measurements still need confirmation.
spatial.no-route-has-been-established-fo: No route has been established for this stage.
spatial.no-supported-route-the-starting-: No supported route: the starting room or a required connection is affected.
spatial.no-supported-route-from-the-reco: No supported route from the recorded starting room. Review the layout, destination and this person's access needs.
spatial.add-and-review-a-home-layout-to-: Add and review a home layout to practice spatial routes. Other scenarios remain available.
spatial.walkout-level-exterior-ground-at: Walkout level — exterior ground at an exit
spatial.window-not-counted-as-an-exit: window — not counted as an exit
spatial.opens-to-a-shared-building-area-: opens to a shared building area that is not modelled
spatial.assumption.fire-before: Exercise: routes before the authored smoke blockage. Starting rooms are recorded household assignments.
spatial.assumption.fire-blocked: Exercise: authored smoke or blockage excludes these rooms and openings. An affected starting room remains exposed; no supported departure is assumed.
spatial.assumption.tornado: Exercise: household-chosen interior shelter, not an engineered safe room. Windows indicate exposure; opening windows does not help.
spatial.assumption.leak: Exercise: a local household leak affects selected spaces. This differs from regional flood evacuation. Keep away from water near electrical equipment; no path through affected space is established.
spatial.assumption.flood-unknown: Exercise: regional flood warning. Indoor water location is unknown; follow official instructions and act early. No indoor route is established.
spatial.assumption.flood-selected: Exercise: selected water-affected spaces are excluded. Higher refuge needs recorded floor relationships; never cross water or enter a closed attic.
spatial.assumption.flood-later: Exercise: a later authored stage excludes connected lower spaces. This topology illustration predicts neither depth nor water arrival time.
spatial.window-exposure: Window exposure: {rooms}. Move away from windows; opening them does not help.
spatial.question.confirmFloor: Where is this captured floor in relation to outside ground? Capture order does not establish ground level.
spatial.question.confirmPortal: Confirm where this opening leads and what is known about using it. A window is not automatically an escape option.
spatial.question.confirmConnector: Confirm both stair landings and whether this connection is usable.
spatial.question.meetingPoint: Choose an outside meeting point away from the home.
spatial.question.shelterSpot: Which interior room on a confirmed lowest floor is away from windows? This is a shelter spot, not an engineered safe room.
spatial.scan-interrupted: Scanning was interrupted. Retry this room or use the rooms already captured.
spatial.scan-camera-denied: Camera access is unavailable. You can add and edit your home manually.
spatial.scan-processing-failed: The scan could not be processed. Your completed room group is retained. {error}
spatial.fact.equipment.runtime: How long {name} runs on its backup
spatial.fact.equipment.backupOutcome: Whether the backup for {name} covers the exercise outage
spatial.fact.backup.setup: Whether {name} is set up and tested
spatial.fact.housing.wellPumpElectric: Whether your well pump needs electricity
spatial.fact.housing.wellPressureTankGal: How much water your pressure tank holds
spatial.fact.supplies.storedWaterGallons: How much water you have stored
spatial.fact.supplies.coolerAndIcePacks: Whether you have a cooler and ice packs
spatial.fact.pets.waterNeeds: How much water your pets need
spatial.fact.home.smokeAlarms: Smoke alarm presence, coverage and functional checks
spatial.fact.home.annotations: Your meeting point and shelter spot
spatial.fact.communications.batteryOrCra: Whether you have a battery or crank radio
spatial.fact.communications.handsetRunti: How long your phones last on battery
spatial.fact.communications.powerBankCha: How many phone charges your power banks hold
spatial.fact.communications.routerOnBack: Whether your router has backup power
spatial.refuge-check: This refuge has a way out and is not a closed attic
spatial.refuge-check-note: Record this only after checking the actual space. A higher room is not automatically a suitable refuge. Follow official flood instructions and act early.
spatial.stair-landings-note: Check both actual landings. Room names alone do not establish a stair connection. Existing landing points must lie inside the selected rooms.
spatial.stair-confirm: I checked both landings and this connection
spatial.stair-invalid: These landing points do not fit the selected rooms on different floors. Leave this stair unconfirmed and correct the capture before using it.
spatial.layout-optional: Your card and preparations work without a layout. Add your own rooms when you are ready to rehearse routes.
spatial.start-empty-layout: Start with one room you know. Add only rooms and connections that describe your home.
spatial.replace-layout: Replace the example layout with your own?
spatial.remove-item-confirm: Remove this item and its room associations?
spatial.outline-note: This changes the room outline, keeping its shape. Openings, stairs, markers and obstacles keep their recorded positions. Check them in the actual room before reviewing the correction.
spatial.review-outline: I checked this corrected outline and the recorded object positions
spatial.shelter-question: I checked this as an interior shelter spot on the lowest floor, away from windows
spatial.place-opening: Place opening on the selected wall
spatial.opening-placement-note: Use only a wall and connection that exist in your home. The opening stays unconfirmed; recorded width and operability are retained. A shared corridor does not establish a building exit.
spatial.invalid-dimensions: Enter finite dimensions greater than {minimum} metres.
spatial.invalid-outline: This outline is invalid. Keep the draft and correct the room before routing.
spatial.overlap-error: This correction would overlap another room. Choose different dimensions or a different position.
spatial.shared-wall-error: Those rooms do not share a wall, so an opening cannot connect them.
spatial.outside-wall-error: That wall is shared with another room. Choose an outside wall.
spatial.short-wall-error: That wall is too short for this opening.
spatial.opening-added: Added. Open it in the list above to confirm it.
spatial.issue.correctedGeometryNeedsRevi: Review this corrected room outline and the positions of its openings, stairs and obstacles before routing.
spatial.issue.connectorGeometryInvalid: Correct both stair landings inside their actual rooms on different floors.
spatial.issue.duplicateID: An item identifier is duplicated. Review the layout.
spatial.issue.unknownFloor: This item refers to a missing floor.
spatial.issue.exteriorGradeUnknown: Confirm how {floor} relates to exterior ground. Captured floor order does not establish a walking exit.
spatial.issue.portalUnverified: Check this opening in the actual home.
spatial.issue.portalSpaceMissing: This opening refers to a missing room.
spatial.issue.portalNotOnSharedBoundary: This opening is not on the boundaries of its rooms. Correct its placement before using it as a connection.
spatial.issue.windowNotAnExit: A window is not an exit until suitability is checked for each person who would use it.
spatial.issue.upperFloorExteriorPortal: Exterior access at this opening has not been established as a walking exit.
spatial.issue.commonAreaOutsideModel: This opens to an unmodeled shared building area. Use the building's posted evacuation plan.
spatial.issue.noVerifiedExteriorExit: No confirmed, usable ground-level exterior exit is recorded.
spatial.issue.connectorUnverified: Check both actual landings and this floor connection.
spatial.issue.spaceLabelUnconfirmed: Confirm the name of this room.
spatial.issue.clearWidthUnknown: Record the measured clear width of this opening.
spatial.issue.structureIncomplete: Parts of this home are not modeled. Review missing rooms and connections.
spatial.issue.overlappingSpaces: These room outlines overlap. Correct them before using their connections.
spatial.issue.shelterCandidateNotEnginee: A shelter candidate is a planning choice, not an engineered safe room.
spatial.floor-summary: {floor} floor plan. Rooms: {rooms}. Confirmed exterior doors: {count}.
spatial.question.confirmRoomGeometry: Does this corrected outline match the actual room and the positions of its openings, stairs and obstacles?
spatial.answer-refused: That answer does not fit this item. Nothing changed. Choose another answer or leave it as not sure.
spatial.level-elevation: Recorded elevation relative to the first level (metres)
spatial.level-note: Add only levels that exist. Lower order numbers mean lower levels. Floor order does not establish exterior ground or usable stairs.
spatial.level-input-error: Enter a level name and a finite, recorded elevation in metres.
spatial.new-stairs-note: Choose both actual landing rooms and record the endpoint on each floor. Adding stairs does not confirm they are usable. No connection is inferred from rooms overlapping on different floors.
spatial.recorded-start-room: Recorded starting room: {room}. The marker represents the room, not a live position.
spatial.start-room-unknown: Starting room not recorded. No position is assumed.
spatial.width-invalid: Enter a positive measurement or clear it for unknown. The previous record is retained until corrected.
spatial.opening.available-exit: Confirmed ground-level exit threshold; a complete route still needs validation
spatial.opening.window-inventory: Window inventory; not an ordinary walking exit
spatial.opening.review-required: Connection or exit suitability still needs review
spatial.opening.unavailable: Not available as a walking connection or ground-level exit
spatial.dollhouse-summary: 3D view of {home}. The room list gives the same information as text.
spatial.exercise-time-spoken: Exercise time: {hours}, {minutes} after the scenario starts
spatial.route-scene-summary: Floor plan with practice routes. The routes are also described in the text above.
spatial.fact.home.portal: The opening used by the exercise route
spatial.fact.savedPlaces: Your saved meeting places and destinations
spatial.fact.home: Home layout has not been added
spatial.fact.transport.alternatives: Your transportation plan without a household vehicle
spatial.fact.transport.destinations.cond: The conditions you have confirmed at the place you plan to go
spatial.fact.regionID: Whether official resources cover your recorded area
spatial.fact.preparedness.reviewedAt: When your family card was last reviewed
spatial.fact.preparedness.water.location: Where your stored water is kept
spatial.scan-note.incomplete-session: Scan session did not finish; parts of the home may be missing.
spatial.scan-note.stair-landings: Stairs detected. Choose both landings; overlapping rooms do not establish a connection.
spatial.scan-note.floor-grade: Confirm each captured floor's relation to exterior ground. The lowest captured story is not necessarily ground level.
spatial.scan-note.large-area: Scanned area exceeds Apple's published multiroom recommendation; check for missing or misplaced rooms.
spatial.scan-note.proposed-openings: Scanned doors and openings are proposals. Confirm each connection and choose your exterior exits.
spatial.scan-note.missing-floor: Room {number}: no floor outline; using the outline of its walls. Needs measurement.
spatial.scan-note.ambiguous-opening: An opening is near more than two rooms; confirm where it leads.
spatial.window-person-question: Who has checked that they can use this window as an escape option?
spatial.window-person-note: Select each person separately after checking exterior access and their ability to use the opening. A window marker alone does not establish an escape route.
spatial.marker-position-note: Choose a position in the room. Apply updates this draft; Save keeps it. A recorded location does not confirm equipment function or shelter protection.
spatial.marker-location-checked: I checked this location in the actual room
spatial.marker-invalid: Choose a reviewed room and a finite point inside it. Correct the room outline first if a suggested position cannot be established. Your previous marker is unchanged.
spatial.no-markers-floor: No safety markers on this floor yet. Add them in the home editor.
spatial.marker-recorded: Location recorded; readiness is checked separately
spatial.fire-no-elevators: Fire practice excludes elevators. Review the building’s posted procedures and assistance arrangements; a missing stair route stays unresolved.
spatial.elevator-excluded: Elevator excluded from practice egress routes
spatial.tap-placement: Tap the position in the selected room.
